svg.title: Where VirtualPyTest uses AI, in one image
svg.text: Most of the lab needs no AI at all: a screen is recognised by its fingerprint,
a key is a key, a load time is a clock. AI is asked only where that is not enough.
Every place the tool asks an AI model, in the order of the doc. Each one is detailed below.
a person only looks at real problems
when the fingerprint is not sure
from plain words: Atlas and Forge
chat, voice, the docs Ask box
the same look and press loop
not a product feature: they change nothing in the product
Used: the answer changes what the tool does. Logged: a shadow answer,
kept to measure the model, nothing changes.
All AI calls of the lab server, 30 days
Paid calls are the fallback when the flat plan fails, plus a few that need a strong model.
Settings → AI picks the model and a fallback for each usage key.
Every cloud call is logged and shown on Monitoring → AI usage.
which screen is this? picture fingerprints
a clock and the screen fingerprint
pixel and sound measurements on the host
after an app update: walks every node, no model
AI only helps Localize on a doubtful match (use case 2).
AI says this is noise, so a person only looks at real problems
USED · real app bug, or noise?
A frozen menu, a phone that went to sleep, a test that failed because the lab network blinked.
When the fingerprint is not sure, read a channel banner, read a score
USED · Tesseract on the host CPU
Localize second opinion is used only to confirm a low-confidence answer.
From plain words, with the Atlas and Forge assistants
All USED. A person reviews what Forge builds.
Questions about the tool, the screen or a run
a free question on the picture
the caller's own model, 0 USD for us
All USED. Masterchief acts only with a confirm card.
the score bug of a match
about the programme, a claim, the news
All USED on the companion panel.
They prove the same look and press loop on harder screens
one screenshot in, one tap out
what went wrong after a game
Benchmarks: the same questions asked to several models to pick a route
They change nothing in the product.
From a paid model to a 0.25 ms classifier
Measured, not wired yet. See the poster Freeze: menu or stuck video?
AI only where nothing simpler can decide.
Every answer is logged, so you can measure what AI really adds.
